$comment: Reviewed differences between the English and Arabic copy that are true on purpose. Each entry needs a reason. scripts/site/copy-parity.mjs fails on any other difference, and on an entry here that no longer matches anything. Paths: `*` is one key, `[*]` any list index, `**` anything.

empty.reason: An empty lead cell on purpose in the /chat demo's tracking panel (the 'Collected' / 'تم التسليم' row has no time), in both languages; ProductDemo.tsx renders the cell so the row keeps its column. Reviewed 24 Oct 2026.
